items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Interviewer mentions talking to Rogers; Interviewee responds with general knowledge about 'them' being punch drunk, but no direct personal interaction or relationship with Rogers is stated by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Yeah, they did pretty good you know, but Freddie was alright, but you know, no ever slight.
Yeah, well one night I was talking to Rogers and I thought he was going to hit me.
